verdict.rationale: Poly's Flashback gives any file or folder a timeline of its entire past, re-rendering the view exactly as it existed at a chosen moment (poly-docs-5). The docs also say even conflicting edits are preserved so any version of any file can be recovered (poly-docs-10), and notes are Markdown files in the Mind folder (poly-docs-12), so this applies to notes. Recovering deleted notes is only implied by the folder-level rewind. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recovering deleted files, detail on how a restore is performed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
